description: This PHP class defines a decorator for the PerformanceTracker entity, providing methods to set related Employee entities by employee number, and to retrieve formatted added and modified dates. It utilizes traits for ORM and DateTime helper functions.

classes.name: PerformanceTrackerDecorator
classes.description: A decorator class providing additional functionalities for the PerformanceTracker entity, such as setting associated Employee entities and retrieving formatted date strings.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the decorator with a PerformanceTracker entity.

methods.name: setEmployeeByEmpNumber
methods.description: Sets the Employee associated with the PerformanceTracker by the employee number.

methods.name: setAddedByByEmpNumber
methods.description: Sets the Employee who added the performance tracker by employee number.

methods.name: getAddedDate
methods.description: Returns the formatted added date of the performance tracker, or null if not set.

methods.name: getModifiedDate
methods.description: Returns the formatted modified date of the performance tracker, or null if not set.
